name: get_balance
description: Native-token balance for an address on a supported EVM chain. Defaults to Ethereum mainnet. Accepts chain by slug (ethereum, polygon, bsc, base, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche, fantom, gnosis, linea, scroll, zksync, blast, mantle) or numeric chain ID.

chain.description: Chain slug or numeric chain ID (default ethereum)

name: get_token_balance
description: ERC-20 token balance for an address against a specific token contract.

chain.description: Chain slug or numeric chain ID (default ethereum)

name: list_transactions
description: List transactions for an address. type controls which list: "normal" (regular EOA txs), "internal" (contract-internal value transfers), "erc20" (ERC-20 transfers), "erc721" (NFT transfers), "erc1155" (multi-token transfers).

type.description: normal | internal | erc20 | erc721 | erc1155 (default normal)

chain.description: Chain slug or chain ID (default ethereum)

name: get_contract_abi
description: Verified contract ABI as JSON (if the contract is verified on Etherscan).

chain.description: Chain slug or chain ID (default ethereum)

name: get_contract_source
description: Verified contract source code, compiler version, optimization settings, and license.

chain.description: Chain slug or chain ID (default ethereum)
